name: record54
caption:
OUR SCORING RECORD 🎮🏀 Not Vince. Not DeMar. The guy nobody drafted.

• Vince Carter: 51 vs Phoenix (Feb 27, 2000). Terrence Ross tied it in 2014
• DeMar DeRozan: 52 vs Milwaukee (Jan 1, 2018). Pascal Siakam matched it in 2022
• Fred VanVleet: 54 vs Orlando (Feb 2, 2021), with 11 threes in a 123-108 win
• The most points ever by an undrafted player, passing Moses Malone's 53

Who breaks 54 next? 👇

facts.claim: Toronto Raptors most points scored in a game (correct as of the end of 2025-26): Fred VanVleet 54 vs Orlando Magic, 2 February 2021 (Feb 2, 2021); DeMar DeRozan 52 vs Milwaukee Bucks, 1 January 2018 (Jan 1, 2018); Pascal Siakam 52 vs New York Knicks, 21 December 2022 (Dec 21, 2022); Vince Carter 51 vs Phoenix Suns, 27 February 2000 (Feb 27, 2000); Terrence Ross 51 vs Los Angeles Clippers, 25 January 2014 (2014). ESPN ids: VanVleet 2991230, DeRozan 3978, Siakam 3149673, Carter 136.

On February 2, 2021, VanVleet scored a career-high 54 points with a career-high 11 three-pointers in a 123-108 victory against Orlando (a 15-point win), a franchise record, and the most points by an undrafted NBA player, previously held by Moses Malone with 53.
No Raptor has scored more than 41 in a game in the first 13 games of 2026-27 (ESPN box scores), so 54 still stands.
